children: Stardust Power amended its prospectus supplement to increase at‑market placement capacity by up to $8,990,537.
Amendment No. 1 updates the Sales Agreement with B. Riley to allow issuance of additional Placement Shares up to $8,990,537.
Placement Shares will be sold pursuant to the company’s Form S-3 registration statement (File No. 333-294938).
Prospectus supplement dated May 8, 2026, as amended, governs the at‑market issuance under the Sales Agreement.
Legal opinion of Thompson Hine LLP regarding the Placement Shares is filed as Exhibit 5.1 to the Form 8-K.
